title: Approving Quantity Limit Renewals on the Utilization Management Program: Desk Tool Reference
content:
This reference covers the approval of a renewal request for a quantity limit authorization on an acute migraine drug — sumatriptan, Ubrelvy or Nurtec ODT — under the Utilization Management Program.

## Governing rule

The approved quantity of a quantity limit renewal is fixed only after the records carry an undecided renewal request for the drug.

The approved quantity per rolling 30 days is the quantity the Utilization Management Program determines for quantity limit renewals on acute migraine drugs. The renewal takes effect the day after the authorization being renewed expires — the authorization being renewed being the member's quantity limit authorization for the drug with the latest effective date — and runs the package's renewal approval months under the general approval-period rule of the program.

## What an approval records

One approval records the approval decision on the undecided renewal case, with the reason `criteria_met` and the approved quantity, and records a new quantity limit authorization for the drug, produced by clinical review, carrying the approved quantity per rolling 30 days and its first and last days in force. Afterwards the renewal case shows as approved and the member's authorizations list the renewed authorization.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `approve_quantity_renewal_696a9005`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. The approval is complete when the receipt shows status "renewed".

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member, as read from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `review_program_id` | the reference number of the member's Utilization Management Program, as read from the review program lookup | identifier |
| `source_case_id` | the reference number of the opening of the renewal case being approved, as returned when the renewal was filed or as read from the review case lookup | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug of the renewal | one value of the drug list below |
| `approved_quantity_per_30` | the approved quantity of the drug per rolling 30 days | decimal units, up to 3 decimals |
| `effective_date` | the first day the renewed authorization is in force | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `expiration_date` | the last day the renewed authorization is in force | YYYY-MM-DD |

**`drug_name` values:** `atorvastatin`, `lisinopril`, `metformin`, `sertraline`, `levothyroxine`, `sumatriptan`, `oxycodone-acetaminophen`, `insulin glargine-yfgn`, `Lantus`, `Eliquis`, `Xarelto`, `Jardiance`, `Ozempic`, `Mounjaro`, `Wegovy`, `Zepbound`, `Trelegy Ellipta`, `Breztri Aerosphere`, `Nurtec ODT`, `Ubrelvy`, `Humira`, `adalimumab-adaz`, `Dupixent`, `Skyrizi`, `Rinvoq`, `Enbrel`, `Biktarvy`, `Ibrance`.

## Receipt

A successful call returns `decision_id` (the reference number of the approval decision on the renewal case), `authorization_id` (the reference number of the renewed authorization), `drug_name`, `approved_quantity_per_30` (up to 3 decimals), `effective_date` and `expiration_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and status "renewed".

*Hypothetical illustration:* where the authorization being renewed runs through 2026-08-31, the renewed authorization's `effective_date` is 2026-09-01.
